steps.label: Eigenvalues of a complex Hermitian matrix
Why eigenvalues come out real
steps.sub: Every Hermitian matrix guarantees this, however complex its entries

code:
Y = np.array([[0, -1j], [1j, 0]])
is_unitary(Y)
# True

S = np.array([[1, 0], [0, 1j]])
is_unitary(S), is_hermitian(S)
# (True, False)
caption: A gate being a valid unitary operation says nothing about whether it's also Hermitian.
